Excited to get NovaPlace into an activation kickoff. We’d like to lock a 60-minute kickoff/working session to align on roles, pre-work, success criteria, and the initial runbook for the Dedicated deployment.

- Tue Jul 27 — 15:00 UTC (08:00 PT)
- Thu Jul 29 — 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT) 
- Fri Jul 30 — 13:00 UTC (06:00 PT)

Agenda (proposed, flexible):
- 5m intro & goals (Rishi)
- 10m customer intro & priorities (Emily + product)
- 25m technical alignment (Camila) — architecture, SSO/SAML notes, data flows
- 15m rollout plan & milestones (Marissa + Vivek)

Can you confirm which slot works for your team and who will attend from NovaPlace? If you want us to invite your integrator, we can include them. Also flag any must-cover items (SAML, logging retention, compliance evidence).
